mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined in terms of potential consumption 'in a period'."
Profit is defined in terms of potential consumption 'in a period'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the final destination of all transactions in the books of prime entries."
The ledger is the final destination of all transactions in the books of prime entries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to record the receipt and payment of small amounts of cash."
The petty cash book is used to record the receipt and payment of small amounts of cash.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to record receipts and payments by cheque."
The two-column cash book is used to record receipts and payments by cheque.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is termed as Debtor's Account and the giving account is called Creditor's Account."
The receiving account is termed as Debtor's Account and the giving account is called Creditor's Account.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a discount given by one trader to another."
A trade discount is a discount given by one trader to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an economic unit separate and apart from the owner or owners."
A business is an economic unit separate and apart from the owner or owners.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used instead of a bank account in the ledger."
The cash book is used instead of a bank account in the ledger.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as "an entity for which there are users who rely on the financial statements as their major source of financial information about the entity" (ASB, 1999)."
A reporting entity is defined as "an entity for which there are users who rely on the financial statements as their major source of financial information about the entity" (ASB, 1999).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the reduction in the amount that the customer has to pay, provided payment is made within a given period stipulated by the seller at the time of sale."
Cash discount is the reduction in the amount that the customer has to pay, provided payment is made within a given period stipulated by the seller at the time of sale.
fib: ______ is a concept, typically defined as the systematic recording of the facts that show the position of a business.
Bookkeeping
Bookkeeping is a concept, typically defined as the systematic recording of the facts that show the position of a business.
______ is used to record a variety of things, most of which consist of accounting adjustments, such as the correction of errors, rather than transactions.
journal
The journal is used to record a variety of things, most of which consist of accounting adjustments, such as the correction of errors, rather than transactions.
______ can be defined as a legal obligation to transfer assets or provide services to another entity that arises from some past transaction or event.
liability
A liability can be defined as a legal obligation to transfer assets or provide services to another entity that arises from some past transaction or event.
______ is a method of bookkeeping that relies on one sided accounting entry to maintain financial information.
single entry bookkeeping
A single entry bookkeeping is a method of bookkeeping that relies on one sided accounting entry to maintain financial information.
______ is a book where goods sold on credit are recorded.
sale day book
The sale day book is a book where goods sold on credit are recorded.
______ is a record in a double entry system that is kept for each class of item.
account
An account is a record in a double entry system that is kept for each class of item.
______ is a method of bookkeeping that relies on two sided accounting entry to maintain financial information.
double entry bookkeeping
A double entry bookkeeping is a method of bookkeeping that relies on two sided accounting entry to maintain financial information.
______ is the system in Accounting whereby every transaction that has to be recorded gives rise to two entries.
Double Entry system
Double Entry system is the system in Accounting whereby every transaction that has to be recorded gives rise to two entries.
______ is a fundamental equation and is a valuable basis from which to begin understanding the whole process of accounting.
accounting equation
The accounting equation is a fundamental equation and is a valuable basis from which to begin understanding the whole process of accounting.
